sections.title: A trusted name *since 1973*

image.alt: The Automotive Workbench shop on East Pine Log Road, with its sign and a palm tree out front

body: Since 1973, Automotive Workbench has been a trusted name in auto repair in Aiken. As one of the oldest independently owned repair shops in the area, we take pride in a decades-long commitment to quality, integrity and service.
We believe trust is earned through honesty: accurate diagnostics and fair pricing, doing what’s right even when no one’s watching. Our goal is long-term relationships, not just transactions.
list: A TechNet Professional Service shop and Aiken Chamber of Commerce member

columns.title: Every visit
items: A clear explanation before any work begins

items.text: Amber J was so sweet! She got me in for a last minute oil change and tire rotation. I don’t come to Aiken often and thought I’d try this place out. I was very pleased with my experience!
This place is great and professional. A special shout out to Rick for ensuring my needs were met. You exceeded above and beyond the call of duty.

items.a: The TechNet nationwide limited repair warranty: 36 months or 36,000 miles on covered parts and labor. More than 25 miles from the shop? Call the warranty administrator at 1-866-588-0728 before any repairs are made.
Yes. Financing through Synchrony lets you get the repair now and pay in monthly payments.

items.q: What cars do you work on?
items.a: Most makes and models, from Toyota, Honda and Ford to BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche: sedans, SUVs and trucks.
Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.
